svg.title: How to read an illustrative Amazon.ca price-history chart
svg.desc: An annotated illustrative chart. A grey band marks a typical low, a high dashed line marks an inflated list price, and a green dip marks an event price. No tracker was read for these dollars.
svg.text: Read the band, not the percentage
Illustrative sketch. ca.camelcamelcamel.com did not load on 26 Sep 2026.
A real discount crosses into the band you have already seen, or beats another Canadian seller.
Write the date, the seller, and whether the line is Was Price or a third-party chart.
Amazon.ca Was Price and 30-day featured-offer lines are defined on the strike-through help page.
